peckish: You could do with a bite to eat.
A faint emptiness in your belly reminds you it's been a while since you ate.
hungry: Your stomach growls. You haven't eaten in a while.
You're hungry; your thoughts keep drifting to food.
A hollow ache sits in your belly. You should eat something.
very hungry: Hunger gnaws at you. It's getting hard to think about anything else.
Your stomach cramps with hunger. You need to eat soon.
You're very hungry. The smell of anything cooking would make your mouth water.
ravenous: You're ravenous; your stomach aches and your temper is short.
You're light-headed with hunger and irritable with everyone.
Hunger has become a pain. You want food, now.
famished: You're famished. You haven't eaten all day and it's all you can think about.
Your belly is a hollow ache and your patience is gone.
You need a proper meal; the hunger makes you short with everyone.

sleepy: A pleasant heaviness is creeping into your limbs.
tired: You're tired. A bed would be very welcome.
You catch yourself yawning again and again.
exhausted: Every step is an effort. You need to sleep.
You're exhausted; your thoughts are slow and muddled.
Your whole body aches with tiredness. You need rest.
collapsing: You can barely stay upright. Your body is going to give out.
Your eyes keep closing on their own. You'll drop where you stand if you don't sleep.
The world sways. You can't stay awake much longer.

hurting: Something aches. You are not quite whole.
You notice a dull pain that was not there before.
weak: You are weak and hurt, and every movement costs you.
Pain throbs through you. You need rest or care.
fading: You're fading. Your strength is draining away; you need help, now.
The edges of the world are going grey.
dying: You're dying. Whatever you do next may be the last thing you do.
Everything is far away and cold.
